verdict.rationale: Zapier's own platform documents triggers as a core building block: integrations define triggers and actions, and the CLI supports webhook and polling triggers. Community users describe multi-step if/then Zaps built by non-programmers, and a Trigger Inbox API exists. However, the evidence comes mainly from the integration-builder side and never shows an ops user setting a Zap to fire on the named event types. missing for 10: end-user docs on starting a Zap from app events, explicit evidence for new record/message/email/form-submission triggers, hands-on corroboration of trigger reliability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can trigger workflows from events in connected apps (new record, message, email, form submission)
